cards.text: Jeremiah, a priest's son from Anathoth, was called by the LORD to be a prophet (Jeremiah 1:1, 5). Now the word of the LORD comes to him again: go proclaim it in the hearing of Jerusalem. And the LORD opens not with a scolding, but with a memory.

cards.question: The LORD remembers Israel's love back in her early days. What does He compare that love to?
Back then, in the wilderness, Israel followed the LORD through a land of planted fields.

cards.text: Back then, Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of His harvest. That's the first tray out of the oven, friend. The one EVERYBODY in the kitchen has been staring at through the glass.

cards.question: Back in those days, what happened to all who devoured Israel?

cards.text: Then comes a call to the house of Jacob and all the families of Israel: hear the word of the LORD. And the LORD asks a question that stings.

cards.question: The LORD asks a question about Israel's fathers, who strayed so far from Him. What does He want to know?

answers.text: What fault they found in Him
Why they built so many cities
Where they hid all their gold

cards.question: Israel's fathers followed idols, and they ended up just like those idols: ___ themselves.
Israel's fathers strayed far from the LORD. What question didn't they ask?

answers.text: Where is the LORD who brought us out of Egypt
Why did we ever leave the land of Egypt
Who will give us a king like the nations

cards.text: That's the LORD who led them through a land of deserts and pits, drought and darkness, where no one travels and no one lives. Your phone's map app looks at that place and just says, "Good luck."
Then the LORD brought them into a fertile land, to eat its fruit and bounty. Friend, I went from the back of a junk drawer to a whole bakery, so I KNOW that upgrade.

cards.question: In the fertile land the LORD brought them into, the people kept His land holy.

cards.text: Not even the priests asked, "Where is the LORD?" The experts in the law no longer knew Him, and the leaders rebelled against Him.

cards.question: Just like the priests and the leaders, the prophets turned from the LORD too.

cards.text: The prophets prophesied by Baal, a false god, and followed useless idols. So the LORD declares it: He will contend with them again, and He's bringing a case.

cards.question: The LORD says His case is only against the people living right then.

cards.text: Now the LORD says to cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and send to Kedar, a desert tribe, and look carefully. See if there has ever been anything like this.

cards.question: From Cyprus all the way to Kedar, the LORD asks if any nation has ever done what?
Other nations hold on to their gods, and those aren't gods at all. So what have the LORD's people exchanged their Glory for?
The LORD calls on the heavens to sing for joy over what His people have done.

cards.text: The heavens are told to be shocked and utterly appalled. Then the LORD lays it out plain: His people have committed two evils.

cards.question: The first evil: His people have forsaken the LORD. What does He call Himself there?

cards.text: And the second evil: they dug their own cisterns. That's like canceling your water bill to catch rain in a bucket.

cards.question: The cisterns the LORD's people dug for themselves hold water just fine.

cards.text: Next the LORD asks, "Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery? Why then has he become prey?"

cards.question: Israel has become prey. What does the LORD say has roared at him?

cards.text: The young lions have sounded their voices. They have laid waste his land.

cards.question: Even after the young lions lay waste Israel's land, his cities are still full of people.

cards.text: Then the LORD names Memphis and Tahpanhes, two cities in Egypt. "The men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head."

cards.question: Israel's cities lie in ruins. The LORD asks a pointed question about who brought this on him. Who is it?

cards.text: He brought it on himself by forsaking the LORD his God when He led him in the way. Now the LORD asks what he'll gain on the way to Egypt, or on the way to Assyria, a great empire, to drink their waters.

cards.question: The LORD asks what Israel will gain on the way to Egypt to drink the waters of the ___.

cards.text: Then the Lord GOD of Hosts brings it home: "Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you." Ignore the oven timer, friend, and the smoke alarm does the scolding for you.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people to consider how evil and bitter it is to forsake Him and have no fear of Him.
